symbols.name: sequence term
symbols.meaning: The number at position k of the sequence, for k from 0 to o.
symbols.quote: The term $\iota_k$ is the number at position $k$, so the sequence is $\iota_0,\iota_1,\dots,\iota_o$.

symbols.name: term index
symbols.meaning: The position of a term in the sequence, running from 0 to o.
symbols.quote: The index $k$ is the position of a term, running from $0$ to $o$; the letter $k$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: last index
symbols.meaning: The index of the last term of the sequence, so the sequence has o+1 terms.
symbols.quote: Let $o$ be the index of the last term of a sequence of real or complex numbers, so the sequence has $o+1$ terms.
